title: The Mexican Presence in Santa Monica Project team
description: At the latest City Council meeting, the Mexican Presence in Santa Monica Project team proudly read the city’s official Hispanic Heritage Month proclamation. From September 15 through October 15, we honor the vibrant cultures, rich languages and significant contributions of Hispanic Heritage in Santa Monica.
transcript_text: This is the Mexican presence [music] in Santa Monica project team and we are receiving the Hispanic Heritage Month proclamation from the city of Santa Monica for 2026. >> Santa Monica aspires [music] to be a city that embraces diversity, inclusion, and [music] equity, and to stand united against all forms of intolerance. At a time [music] when immigrant communities, many of them Hispanic and Latino, continue to face rising [music] challenges and uncertainty, we are reminded that the struggle continues. This Hispanic Heritage [music] Month is an especially important moment to reframe that Santa Monica is and will remain [music] a city for everyone.
